sfprodisplay.reason: Inter is a screen-first neo-grotesque with optical sizing like SF Pro; Geist is a close modern neutral grotesque; Roboto is more mechanical.

sfprotext.reason: Same family as SF Pro Display; Inter's text-size spacing and open apertures match closely.

sfpro.reason: Generic San Francisco UI face; Inter is the most widely cited near-equivalent, slightly wider letterforms.

sfmono.reason: Clean neutral monospaces with similar proportions.

spotifycircular.reason: Circular is a geometric sans with round bowls; none match its proportions exactly.

spotifymix.reason: Circular-derived successor; Circular alternatives assumed to apply.

airbnbcereal.reason: Friendly geometric sans in the Circular/Avenir space; weak evidence.

twitterchirp.reason: Grotesque with softer details; Inter and DM Sans are named as nearest free options.

stripesohne.reason: Sohne is a Helvetica/Akzidenz-inspired neo-grotesque; Inter shares its neutral proportions but is less warm.

segoeui.reason: Humanist sans with open apertures and similar x-height; same designer lineage.

helveticanowdisplay.reason: Inter is a neutral grotesque comparable to Helvetica; Helvetica Now has finer details.

helveticanowtext.reason: Same as Helvetica Now Display; Arimo matches Helvetica/Arial widths.

nikefuturand.reason: Customised Futura; Jost is the most cited Futura-inspired geometric sans but has no extra-bold condensed cut.

amazonember.reason: Softly rounded terminals and generous x-height; aggregator-level evidence.

netflixsans.reason: Clean modern sans; generic nearest suggestions only.

ubermove.reason: Neutral grotesque with generous x-height; aggregator-level evidence.

slacklarsseit.reason: Geometric-grotesque; Larsseit is rounder than Inter.

metaoptimistic.reason: Friendly humanist-geometric sans; Optimistic is rounder and warmer.

canela.reason: Both are soft, high-contrast display serifs; Fraunces is chunkier and quirkier than Canela.

tiempostext.reason: Lora is a contemporary editorial text serif with similar warmth but wider, more brushed curves.

chronicledisplay.reason: Both are high-contrast transitional display serifs; Playfair has a larger x-height and sharper contrast.

minionpro.reason: Old-style book serif with a similarly classical feel; a little lighter than Minion.

plantin.reason: Both are sturdy old-style book serifs; Crimson is lighter and finer.

adobegaramond.reason: EB Garamond is a revival of the same Garamont lineage; Cormorant is more delicate.

garamondpremierpro.reason: Same Garamont-derived lineage; Premier Pro has optical sizes.

baskerville.reason: Based on the ATF Baskerville; same transitional structure, slightly wider with a larger x-height for web text.

bodoni.reason: Libre Bodoni is based on ATF Bodoni; Bodoni Moda is a full Bodoni revival.

didot.reason: Didot and Bodoni are both modern serifs with extreme contrast; Bodoni is slightly heavier and more geometric.

caslon.reason: Libre Caslon Text is a Caslon revival based on ATF Caslon.

gotham.reason: Montserrat is the most cited match for Gotham's wide geometric bold capitals; it is wider and differs in letter details.

myriadpro.reason: Humanist sans with similar proportions; slightly more condensed with sturdier forms.

frutiger.reason: Both are open humanist sans-serifs; the claim rests on a single listing.

gillsans.reason: Lato is a humanist sans but lacks Gill's classical Roman proportions.

tradegothic.reason: Both are American grotesques, but Libre Franklin is a Franklin Gothic revival and differs in detail.

trajanpro.reason: Cinzel is inspired by classical Roman inscriptional capitals, the same source as Trajan.

proximanova.reason: Montserrat is a classic stand-in (wider, more geometric); Figtree follows Proxima's lowered-crossbar capitals and is friendlier.

circular.reason: Figtree is listed as the closest Google Font to Circular, Plus Jakarta Sans as best overall.

avenirnext.reason: Montserrat is rated the best Avenir replacement (wider); Mulish is neutral and geometric like Avenir.

avenir.reason: Montserrat is rated the best Avenir replacement (wider); Mulish is neutral and geometric like Avenir.

sofiapro.reason: Poppins is called the closest Google Font (good for body text, less so for uppercase headlines).

akkurat.reason: Work Sans is cited as a close match, from aggregator sites only.

helveticanow.reason: Inter is a neutral neo-grotesque close to Helvetica; it has a taller x-height and different details.

neuehaasgrotesk.reason: Inter is rated the closest free match; more screen-tuned with a taller x-height.

futura.reason: Jost is a Futura-inspired geometric sans and the consensus free alternative.

dinnext.reason: Barlow is repeatedly called the closest Google Font to DIN; slightly more rounded.

din.reason: Barlow is repeatedly called the closest Google Font to DIN; slightly more rounded.

brandongrotesque.reason: Hard to match: Cabin matches the g and rounded details, Josefin Sans the quirky geometric feel. None is exact.

gilroy.reason: Poppins is consistently picked for Gilroy's geometric proportions; Manrope for its warmth.

graphik.reason: Neutral grotesque; Inter is a judgement call with no direct source.

productsans.reason: Roundups group these as clean geometric sans similar to Product Sans; no authoritative comparison.
